items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Myself, and the Shelley Lamelle trumpet player, second trumpet player to me.

ctx.x: I was looking at it, got my seat out of it.
Myself, and the Shelley Lamelle trumpet player, second trumpet player to me. I think he might still be playing.
Is he from out in the country?
